results.title: Who's Coming for Christmas?
results.overview: After relocating to a new town, Julie uses pieces inherited from her late grandmother to create a beautiful Christmas Eve dinner table for eight, trusting that the right guests will find their way to it. As she befriends her neighbor Mark and his young daughter, her holiday plans seem complete, until bad weather keeps them away. With only three seats filled, Julie must rely on a series of small Christmas miracles to bring her dream holiday table to life.

results.title: IceGuys: The Movie
results.overview: When Iceland's hottest boyband ICEGUYS accidentally enters an international reality show competition, they must out-sing, out-dance and out-last other rival boy bands to win a coveted opening slot on an upcoming world tour.

results.title: The Nine O'Clock Trot
results.overview: Annie (Kalli Tant) is a recent graduate who has spent six months caring full-time for her grandfather. When he dies, she is broke, unemployed, and unable to afford a funeral. Refusing an unbearable council public health funeral, she keeps his death a secret and turns to the local parish priest, becoming entangled with Father Adam (Johnny Vegas).

results.title: Return to the Jaws of Darkness
results.original_title: Return to the Jaws of Darkness
results.overview: Six months after his harrowing escape from a mysterious Russian island, Jake Fernsby is still drowning in PTSD. When a distress signal suddenly comes up from a missing fighter pilot, Jake and a crack team of soldiers are selected to save the pilot. Unbeknownst to Jake and his squad, they're being sent straight into the Beast's home turf.

results.title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in São Paulo
results.original_title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in São Paulo
results.overview: The Latin American leg of BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ reaches the big screen through a delayed presentation of the São Paulo concert. It brings the scale and excitement of BTS’s stadium performance into the cinema, offering fans a communal live-viewing experience shaped by the energy of a packed Brazilian venue.

results.title: Scorpion
results.overview: A teen’s mistake exposes her father as Scorpion, a retired CIA assassin, forcing them on the run from his former mentor and the deadly operatives of The Zoo.

results.title: Bad Trip
results.overview: A person struggles to maintain their sense of time.

results.title: Pulavar
results.overview: A unique retired police officer uses storytelling and his understanding of the human mind to uncover the truth behind crimes committed by criminals who refuse to confess, even after facing beatings and threats.

results.title: Noutro tempo
results.overview: Beto, a retired soccer player, returns to his city to start a routine job. He stays in a family apartment with his niece Elisa, focused on the preparation of some oppositions. Throughout a day, the story follows her wandering through the streets, in contrast to her daily routine. At the end and at the end of the day both share memories and silences.

results.title: i <3 seals
results.overview: "i <3 seals" is a music video by American underground rapper bleood, directed by noahsocold. Released on YouTube on April 24, 2026, it promotes bleood's song of the same name, matching its woozy, rage-tinged sound.

results.title: Time & Time Again
results.overview: After moving homes, a young couple acquire the Timecrowave, a mysterious microwave that ages anything placed inside.

results.title: Dissidence - Two Shadows on the Wall
results.original_title: Dissidence. Deux ombres sur le mur
results.overview: Ravianto and Raviandi Ramadhan are two newcomers to the World Climbing Championships scene. Driven only by passion and lofty aspirations, two Indonesian twin brothers set out into the world without sponsors. The documentary "Dissidence" chronicles their incredible trip from the fabled crags of France to the climbing walls of their native country. It is a heartfelt homage to their bravery, fraternity, and tenacity. Ravianto and Raviandi fight to have their views heard internationally while challenging the current quo.

results.title: Arrow
results.overview: On his first Boy Scout camping trip, 12 year old Wesley tries to win back his best friend by joining the coveted (and top secret) Order of the Arrow.

results.title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
results.original_title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
results.overview: Legendary "SCTV" cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how a scrappy Canadian sketch show made comedy history.

results.title: Paging Hezbollah
results.overview: Paging Hezbollah is the extraordinary true story behind an intelligence operation that seemed impossible—how it was conceived, engineered and carried out, as well as the profound geopolitical consequences that followed.

results.title: Exposure
results.overview: An anxious small-town cop falls down a rabbit hole after finding a VHS tape in a missing girl's bedroom.

results.title: Ebenezer Scrooge: A Christmas Carol Horror
results.original_title: Ebenezer Scrooge: A Christmas Carol Horror
results.overview: A horror take on the classic tale. When cruel businessman Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by ghosts on Christmas Eve, he will have to decide whether to heed their warning to change for the better or remain cold-hearted and merciless.

results.title: The Potentials
results.overview: Teruichi Tsuchiya, 42, is a perpetual assistant to a master manga artist. He feels uneasy about his junior colleague who has debuted as a manga artist, his estranged wife who is a popular voice actress, and for some reason, he is constantly at odds with his daughter, who lives with him and is preparing for her high school entrance exams. Just as a 17-year-old manga series comes to an end, a new manga project comes along. Joining him are Yuki Shioda, a 29-year-old editor who is aware of his lack of passion for his work, and Potato Yamada, a headstrong 40-year-old rookie assistant. What future awaits him after taking this step…?

results.title: Sister Sister 3
results.overview: Set in traditional Northern Vietnam, where strict social norms prevail, Thi Mau - the region's most beautiful and talented young lady - finds herself caught in a tangled web of secret love and conflicting desires.
